title: Cancer Trial Failures, Study Retractions Highlight Oncology Research Challenges
abstract: # Cancer Trial Failures, Study Retractions Highlight Oncology Research Challenges. Recent headlines involving cancer study retractions, clinical trial failures, and shifting regulatory decisions underscore ongoing oncology research challenges. ## Top Journal Retracts Cancer Study After Investigation. ## Phase 3 Cancer Trial Halted as Monoclonal Antibody Combo Fails to Improve Survival. Despite positive topline progression-free survival data from the phase 3 EMBER-3 trial, Lilly will not seek broad approval for its oral SERD imlunestrant (Inluriyo) combined with the CDK4/6 inhibitor abemaciclib (Verzenio) in all patients with estrogen receptor–positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer. Arcus and Gilead have discontinued development of domvanalimab, an anti-TIGIT antibody, in gastric and esophageal cancers after the failure of the phase 3 STAR-221 trial, which showed no improvement in overall survival compared with standard therapy. ## Monoclonal Antibody Fails to Improve Survival in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Trial. Cantargia reported no median overall survival benefit in its phase 1b/2 TRIFOUR trial of the monoclonal antibody nadunolimab plus gemcitabine/carboplatin in triple-negative breast cancer.
